312	import { useCallback, useEffect, useMemo, useState } from 'react'
313	
314	import { HarnessClient } from '@/lib/api'
315	import { resolveConfig, type ResolvedConfig } from '@/lib/config'
316	import { getLogger } from '@/lib/log'
317	import type { Health, Scenario } from '@/lib/types'
318	
319	const log = getLogger('web')
320	
321	export interface HarnessState {
322	  base: string | null
323	  reachable: boolean
324	  source: ResolvedConfig['source'] | null
325	  health: Health | null
326	  healthError: string | null
327	  scenarios: Scenario[]
328	  scenariosError: string | null
329	  loading: boolean
330	  refresh: () => void
331	  client: HarnessClient | null
332	}
333	
334	export function useHarness(): HarnessState {
335	  const [cfg, setCfg] = useState<ResolvedConfig | null>(null)
336	  const [health, setHealth] = useState<Health | null>(null)
337	  const [healthError, setHealthError] = useState<string | null>(null)
338	  const [scenarios, setScenarios] = useState<Scenario[]>([])
339	  const [scenariosError, setScenariosError] = useState<string | null>(null)
340	  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true)
341	  const [nonce, setNonce] = useState(0)
342	
343	  useEffect(() => {
344	    let cancelled = false
345	    setLoading(true)
346	
347	    void (async () => {
348	      const resolved = await resolveConfig()
349	      if (cancelled) return
350	      setCfg(resolved)
351	      log.info('config.resolved', 'harness URL resolved', {
352	        harness_url: resolved.harnessUrl,
353	        source: resolved.source,
354	      })
355	      const client = new HarnessClient(resolved.harnessUrl)
356	
357	      const [h, s] = await Promise.allSettled([client.health(), client.scenarios()])
358	      if (cancelled) return
359	
360	      if (h.status === 'fulfilled') {
361	        setHealth(h.value)
362	        setHealthError(null)
363	        log.info('health.ok', 'harness reachable', {
364	          model_default: h.value.model_default ?? null,
365	          has_provider_key: h.value.has_provider_key,
366	        })
367	      } else {
368	        setHealth(null)
369	        setHealthError(String(h.reason))
370	        log.warn('health.error', 'harness unreachable', { error: String(h.reason) })
371	      }
372	
373	      if (s.status === 'fulfilled') {
374	        setScenarios(s.value)
375	        setScenariosError(null)
376	        log.info('scenarios.loaded', 'catalogue loaded', { count: s.value.length })
377	      } else {
378	        setScenarios([])
379	        setScenariosError(String(s.reason))
380	        log.warn('scenarios.error', 'GET /scenarios failed', { error: String(s.reason) })
381	      }
382	
383	      setLoading(false)
384	    })()
385	
386	    return () => {
387	      cancelled = true
388	    }
389	  }, [nonce])
390	
391	  const refresh = useCallback(() => setNonce((n) => n + 1), [])
392	
393	  const client = useMemo(
394	    () => (cfg ? new HarnessClient(cfg.harnessUrl) : null),
395	    [cfg],
396	  )
397	
398	  return {
399	    base: cfg?.harnessUrl ?? null,
400	    reachable: health?.ok === true,
401	    source: cfg?.source ?? null,
402	    health,
403	    healthError,
404	    scenarios,
405	    scenariosError,
406	    loading,
407	    refresh,
408	    client,
409	  }
410	}

412	
413	import { useCallback, useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react'
414	
415	import { HarnessClient, subscribeRun, type Subscription, type TransportState } from '@/lib/api'
416	import { getLogger } from '@/lib/log'
417	import { fromRunRecord, initialState, reduce, type ViewState } from '@/lib/reducer'
418	import { DEMOS, loadDemo, playReplay, type ReplayHandle } from '@/lib/replay'
419	import type { Event } from '@/lib/types'
420	
421	const log = getLogger('web')
422	
423	export type RunSource =
424	  | { kind: 'none' }
425	  | { kind: 'live'; runId: string }
426	  | { kind: 'demo'; demoId: string }
427	
428	export interface RunViewState {
429	  state: ViewState
430	  transport: TransportState | null
431	  loadError: string | null
432	  loading: boolean
433	  replaying: boolean
434	}
435	
436	export function useRunView(client: HarnessClient | null, source: RunSource): RunViewState {
437	  const [state, setState] = useState<ViewState>(initialState)
438	  const [transport, setTransport] = useState<TransportState | null>(null)
439	  const [loadError, setLoadError] = useState<string | null>(null)
440	  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(source.kind !== 'none')
441	  const [replaying, setReplaying] = useState(false)
442	
443	  const subRef = useRef<Subscription | null>(null)
444	  const replayRef = useRef<ReplayHandle | null>(null)
445	
446	  const push = useCallback((events: Event[]) => {
447	    setState((prev) => events.reduce(reduce, prev))
448	  }, [])
449	
450	  const key =
451	    source.kind === 'live'
452	      ? `live:${source.runId}`
453	      : source.kind === 'demo'
454	        ? `demo:${source.demoId}`
455	        : 'none'
456	
457	  useEffect(() => {
458	    let cancelled = false
459	
460	    const teardown = () => {
461	      subRef.current?.close()
462	      subRef.current = null
463	      replayRef.current?.stop()
464	      replayRef.current = null
465	    }
466	
467	    teardown()
468	    setState(initialState())
469	    setTransport(null)
470	    setLoadError(null)
471	    setReplaying(false)
472	
473	    const stop = () => {
474	      cancelled = true
475	      teardown()
476	    }
477	
478	    if (key === 'none') {
479	      setLoading(false)
480	      return stop
481	    }
482	
483	    setLoading(true)
484	
485	    if (key.startsWith('demo:')) {
486	      const demoId = key.slice('demo:'.length)
487	      const meta = DEMOS.find((d) => d.id === demoId)
488	      void (async () => {
489	        try {
490	          if (!meta) throw new Error(`no bundled demo named "${demoId}"`)
491	          const rec = await loadDemo(meta.file)
492	          if (cancelled) return
493	          const seeded = fromRunRecord({ ...rec, events: [], evaluation: null, finished_at: null })
494	          setState({ ...seeded, status: 'running', evaluation: null })
495	          setLoading(false)
496	          setReplaying(true)
497	          log.info('demo.loaded', 'bundled demo loaded', { demo: demoId, events: rec.events.length })
498	          replayRef.current = playReplay({
499	            events: rec.events,
500	            onEvents: push,
501	            onDone: () => {
502	              if (!cancelled) setReplaying(false)
503	              log.info('demo.finished', 'replay complete', { demo: demoId })
504	            },
505	          })
506	        } catch (err) {
507	          if (cancelled) return
508	          setLoading(false)
509	          setLoadError(String(err))
510	          log.error('demo.error', 'failed to load bundled run', { demo: demoId, error: String(err) })
511	        }
512	      })()
513	      return stop
514	    }
515	
516	    const runId = key.slice('live:'.length)
517	    if (!client) {
518	      setLoading(false)
519	      setLoadError('harness URL not resolved yet')
520	      return stop
521	    }
522	
523	    void (async () => {
524	      let from = -1
525	      try {
526	        const rec = await client.getRun(runId)
527	        if (cancelled) return
528	        setState(fromRunRecord(rec))
529	        from = rec.events?.length ? Math.max(...rec.events.map((e) => e.id)) : -1
530	        log.info('run.restored', 'seeded view from GET /runs/{id}', {
531	          run_id: runId,
532	          events: rec.events?.length ?? 0,
533	          status: rec.status,
534	        })
535	      } catch (err) {
536	        if (cancelled) return
537	        setLoadError(String(err))
538	        log.warn('run.load_error', 'GET /runs failed; relying on the stream', {
539	          run_id: runId,
540	          error: String(err),
541	        })
542	      }
543	      if (cancelled) return
544	      setLoading(false)
545	      subRef.current = subscribeRun({
546	        base: client.base,
547	        runId,
548	        lastEventId: from,
549	        onEvents: push,
550	        onRecord: (r) => {
551	          setState((prev) => ({
552	            ...prev,
553	            status: r.status ?? prev.status,
554	            usage: r.usage ?? prev.usage,
555	            evaluation: r.evaluation ?? prev.evaluation,
556	            error: r.error ?? prev.error,
557	            finishedAt: r.finished_at ?? prev.finishedAt,
558	          }))
559	        },
560	        onTransport: (t) => {
561	          if (!cancelled) setTransport(t)
562	        },
563	      })
564	    })()
565	
566	    return stop
567	  }, [key, client, push])
568	
569	  return { state, transport, loadError, loading, replaying }
570	}

573	import { getLogger } from './log'
574	import type { Event, RunRecord } from './types'
575	
576	const log = getLogger('web')
577	
578	export const DEMO_STEP_MS = 400
579	
580	export interface DemoMeta {
581	  id: string
582	  label: string
583	  file: string
584	}
585	
586	export const DEMOS: DemoMeta[] = [
587	  { id: 'lost-ack', label: 'lost-ack', file: '/demo/lost-ack.json' },
588	]
589	
590	export function demoFor(scenarioId: string): DemoMeta | undefined {
591	  return DEMOS.find((d) => d.id === scenarioId)
592	}
593	
594	export async function loadDemo(
595	  file: string,
596	  fetchImpl: typeof fetch = fetch,
597	): Promise<RunRecord> {
598	  const res = await fetchImpl(file, { cache: 'no-store' })
599	  if (!res.ok) throw new Error(`demo ${file} not found (${res.status})`)
600	  const rec = (await res.json()) as RunRecord
601	  if (!Array.isArray(rec?.events)) throw new Error(`demo ${file} has no events`)
602	  return rec
603	}
604	
605	export interface ReplayHandle {
606	  stop: () => void
607	}
608	
609	export interface ReplayOptions {
610	  events: Event[]
611	  onEvents: (events: Event[]) => void
612	  onDone?: () => void
613	  stepMs?: number
614	  setTimeoutImpl?: (fn: () => void, ms: number) => unknown
615	  clearTimeoutImpl?: (h: unknown) => void
616	}
617	
618	export function playReplay(opts: ReplayOptions): ReplayHandle {
619	  const {
620	    events,
621	    onEvents,
622	    onDone,
623	    stepMs = DEMO_STEP_MS,
624	    setTimeoutImpl = (fn, ms) => setTimeout(fn, ms),
625	    clearTimeoutImpl = (h) => clearTimeout(h as ReturnType<typeof setTimeout>),
626	  } = opts
627	
628	  let i = 0
629	  let handle: unknown = null
630	  let stopped = false
631	
632	  log.info('replay.start', 'playing bundled demo', { events: events.length, step_ms: stepMs })
633	
634	  const tick = () => {
635	    if (stopped) return
636	    const ev = events[i]
637	    i += 1
638	    if (!ev) {
639	      log.info('replay.done', 'demo finished', { events: events.length })
640	      onDone?.()
641	      return
642	    }
643	    onEvents([ev])
644	    handle = setTimeoutImpl(tick, stepMs)
645	  }
646	
647	  tick()
648	
649	  return {
650	    stop: () => {
651	      if (stopped) return
652	      stopped = true
653	      if (handle !== null) clearTimeoutImpl(handle)
654	      log.info('replay.stop', 'demo stopped by caller', { delivered: i })
655	    },
656	  }
657	}

664	}

666	export class HarnessClient {
667	  constructor(
668	    readonly base: string,
669	    private readonly fetchImpl: typeof fetch = fetch,
670	  ) {}
671	
672	  health(signal?: AbortSignal): Promise<Health> {
673	    return jsonFetch<Health>(`${this.base}/health`, { signal }, this.fetchImpl)
674	  }
675	
676	  scenarios(signal?: AbortSignal): Promise<Scenario[]> {
677	    return jsonFetch<Scenario[]>(`${this.base}/scenarios`, { signal }, this.fetchImpl)
678	  }
679	
680	  createRun(req: RunRequest, signal?: AbortSignal): Promise<{ run_id: string }> {
681	    log.info('run.create', 'POST /runs', {
682	      scenario_id: req.scenario_id,
683	      model: req.model ?? null,
684	    })
685	    return jsonFetch<{ run_id: string }>(
686	      `${this.base}/runs`,
687	      {
688	        method: 'POST',
689	        headers: { 'content-type': 'application/json' },
690	        body: JSON.stringify(req),
691	        signal,
692	      },
693	      this.fetchImpl,
694	    )
695	  }
696	
697	  getRun(runId: string, signal?: AbortSignal): Promise<RunRecord> {
698	    return jsonFetch<RunRecord>(
699	      `${this.base}/runs/${encodeURIComponent(runId)}`,
700	      { signal },
701	      this.fetchImpl,
702	    )
703	  }
704	}
705	
706	export type TransportMode = 'sse' | 'poll' | 'closed'
707	
708	export interface TransportState {
709	  mode: TransportMode
710	  errors: number
711	  detail?: string
712	}
713	
714	export interface SubscribeOptions {
715	  base: string
716	  runId: string
717	  lastEventId?: number
718	  onEvents: (events: Event[]) => void
719	  onRecord?: (record: RunRecord) => void
720	  onTransport?: (state: TransportState) => void
721	  onDone?: () => void
722	  eventSourceImpl?: typeof EventSource | null
723	  fetchImpl?: typeof fetch
724	  pollIntervalMs?: number
725	  reconnectDelayMs?: number
726	  maxSseErrors?: number
727	  setTimeoutImpl?: (fn: () => void, ms: number) => unknown
728	  clearTimeoutImpl?: (handle: unknown) => void
729	}
730	
731	export interface Subscription {
732	  close: () => void
733	  state: () => TransportState
734	}
735	
736	function parseEvent(raw: string): Event | null {
737	  try {
738	    const v = JSON.parse(raw) as Event
739	    return typeof v?.id === 'number' && typeof v?.type === 'string' ? v : null
740	  } catch {
741	    return null
742	  }
743	}
744	
745	export function subscribeRun(opts: SubscribeOptions): Subscription {
746	  const {
747	    base,
748	    runId,
749	    onEvents,
750	    onRecord,
751	    onTransport,
752	    onDone,
753	    fetchImpl = typeof fetch !== 'undefined' ? fetch : undefined,
754	    pollIntervalMs = 1500,
755	    reconnectDelayMs = 1000,
756	    maxSseErrors = 2,
757	    setTimeoutImpl = (fn, ms) => setTimeout(fn, ms),
758	    clearTimeoutImpl = (h) => clearTimeout(h as ReturnType<typeof setTimeout>),
759	  } = opts
760	
761	  const ESImpl =
762	    opts.eventSourceImpl !== undefined
763	      ? opts.eventSourceImpl
764	      : typeof EventSource !== 'undefined'
765	        ? EventSource
766	        : null
767	
768	  let lastEventId = opts.lastEventId ?? -1
769	  let closed = false
770	  let es: EventSource | null = null
771	  let timer: unknown = null
772	  let transport: TransportState = { mode: 'sse', errors: 0 }
773	
774	  const setTransport = (patch: Partial<TransportState>) => {
775	    transport = { ...transport, ...patch }
776	    onTransport?.(transport)
777	  }
778	
779	  const clearTimer = () => {
780	    if (timer !== null) {
781	      clearTimeoutImpl(timer)
782	      timer = null
783	    }
784	  }
785	
786	  const emit = (events: Event[]) => {
787	    const fresh = events.filter((e) => e.id > lastEventId)
788	    if (fresh.length === 0) return
789	    lastEventId = Math.max(lastEventId, ...fresh.map((e) => e.id))
790	    onEvents(fresh)
791	  }
792	
793	  const finish = (reason: string) => {
794	    if (closed) return
795	    log.info('stream.done', reason, { run_id: runId, last_event_id: lastEventId })
796	    closed = true
797	    es?.close()
798	    es = null
799	    clearTimer()
800	    setTransport({ mode: 'closed', detail: reason })
801	    onDone?.()
802	  }
803	
804	  const pollOnce = async () => {
805	    if (closed || !fetchImpl) return
806	    try {
807	      const rec = await jsonFetch<RunRecord>(
808	        `${base}/runs/${encodeURIComponent(runId)}`,
809	        {},
810	        fetchImpl,
811	      )
812	      onRecord?.(rec)
813	      emit(rec.events ?? [])
814	      if (isTerminal(rec.status)) {
815	        finish('run reached a terminal status (poll)')
816	        return
817	      }
818	    } catch (err) {
819	      log.warn('poll.error', 'GET /runs failed', { run_id: runId, error: String(err) })
820	      setTransport({ detail: String(err) })
821	    }
822	    if (!closed) timer = setTimeoutImpl(() => void pollOnce(), pollIntervalMs)
823	  }
824	
825	  const startPolling = (why: string) => {
826	    if (closed) return
827	    es?.close()
828	    es = null
829	    clearTimer()
830	    log.warn('stream.fallback', `switching to polling: ${why}`, {
831	      run_id: runId,
832	      interval_ms: pollIntervalMs,
833	    })
834	    setTransport({ mode: 'poll', detail: why })
835	    void pollOnce()
836	  }
837	
838	  const openSse = () => {
839	    if (closed || !ESImpl) return
840	    const url = new URL(`${base}/runs/${encodeURIComponent(runId)}/events`)
841	    if (lastEventId >= 0) url.searchParams.set('last_event_id', String(lastEventId))
842	    let deliveredThisStream = 0
843	
844	    log.info('stream.open', 'opening SSE', { run_id: runId, url: url.toString() })
845	    const source = new ESImpl(url.toString())
846	    es = source
847	
848	    const handle = (e: MessageEvent) => {
849	      const ev = parseEvent(e.data as string)
850	      if (!ev) {
851	        log.warn('stream.parse_error', 'unparseable SSE frame', { run_id: runId })
852	        return
853	      }
854	      deliveredThisStream += 1
855	      if (transport.errors !== 0) setTransport({ errors: 0, detail: undefined })
856	      emit([ev])
857	      if (ev.type === 'run.finished') {
858	        log.info('stream.run_finished', 'run.finished seen', { run_id: runId })
859	      }
860	    }
861	
862	    source.addEventListener('message', handle as EventListener)
863	    for (const t of EVENT_TYPES) source.addEventListener(t, handle as EventListener)
864	    source.addEventListener('done', (() => {
865	      finish('server sent `event: done`')
866	    }) as EventListener)
867	
868	    source.addEventListener('open', () => {
869	      log.info('stream.connected', 'SSE open', { run_id: runId })
870	      setTransport({ mode: 'sse' })
871	    })
872	
873	    source.addEventListener('error', () => {
874	      if (closed) return
875	      source.close()
876	      if (es === source) es = null
877	      if (deliveredThisStream > 0) {
878	        log.info('stream.rotate', 'stream closed after delivering events; reconnecting', {
879	          run_id: runId,
880	          delivered: deliveredThisStream,
881	          last_event_id: lastEventId,
882	        })
883	        setTransport({ errors: 0 })
884	        timer = setTimeoutImpl(openSse, 0)
885	        return
886	      }
887	      const errors = transport.errors + 1
888	      setTransport({ errors, detail: 'EventSource error' })
889	      log.warn('stream.error', 'SSE failed before delivering anything', {
890	        run_id: runId,
891	        errors,
892	      })
893	      if (errors >= maxSseErrors) {
894	        startPolling(`${errors} consecutive EventSource errors`)
895	        return
896	      }
897	      timer = setTimeoutImpl(openSse, reconnectDelayMs)
898	    })
899	  }
900	
901	  if (ESImpl) {
902	    openSse()
903	  } else {
904	    startPolling('EventSource unavailable in this environment')
905	  }
906	
907	  return {
908	    close: () => {
909	      if (closed) return
910	      closed = true
911	      es?.close()
912	      es = null
913	      clearTimer()
914	      setTransport({ mode: 'closed', detail: 'closed by caller' })
915	      log.info('stream.close', 'subscription closed by caller', { run_id: runId })
916	    },
917	    state: () => transport,
918	  }
919	}

41	export function RunHeader({
42	  state,
43	  transport,
44	  replaying,
45	  onBack,
46	}: {
47	  state: ViewState
48	  transport: TransportState | null
49	  replaying: boolean
50	  onBack: () => void
51	}) {
52	  const [, setTick] = useState(0)
53	  const live = state.status === 'running' || state.status === 'queued'
54	  useEffect(() => {
55	    if (!live) return
56	    const t = setInterval(() => setTick((n) => n + 1), 1000)
57	    return () => clearInterval(t)
58	  }, [live])
59	
60	  const faults = faultCount(state)
61	  const recovered = recoveredCount(state)
62	
63	  return (
64	    <header className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-x-5 gap-y-3 border-b border-border bg-card/40 px-4 py-3">
65	      <Button variant="ghost" size="sm" onClick={onBack} className="-ml-1">
66	        <ArrowLeft aria-hidden /> Scenarios
67	      </Button>
68	
69	      <div className="min-w-0">
70	        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
71	          <h1 className="truncate font-mono text-sm font-medium">{state.scenarioId ?? '—'}</h1>
72	          <Badge variant="outline" className={`font-mono ${STATUS_TONE[state.status]}`}>
73	            {replaying ? 'replay' : state.status}
74	          </Badge>
75	          {transport && transport.mode !== 'closed' ? (
76	            <Tooltip>
77	              <TooltipTrigger
78	                render={
79	                  <Badge variant="outline" className="font-mono text-muted-foreground">
80	                    <Radio aria-hidden /> {transport.mode}
81	                  </Badge>
82	                }
83	              />
84	              <TooltipContent>
85	                {transport.mode === 'sse'
86	                  ? 'Live SSE tail; the harness rotates the stream every ~110 s and we resume with Last-Event-ID.'
87	                  : 'SSE failed twice in a row — falling back to polling GET /runs/{id} every 1.5 s.'}
88	              </TooltipContent>
89	            </Tooltip>
90	          ) : null}
91	        </div>
92	        <p className="mt-0.5 truncate font-mono text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">
93	          {state.runId ?? '—'}
94	          {state.episodeId ? ` · ${state.episodeId}` : ''}
95	        </p>
96	      </div>
97	
98	      <Separator orientation="vertical" className="hidden h-8 lg:block" />
99	
100	      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-x-5 gap-y-2">
101	        <Stat label="model" value={state.model ?? '—'} />
102	        <Stat label="step" value={`${state.step}/${state.maxSteps}`} />
103	        <Stat
104	          label="tokens"
105	          value={`${fmtTokens(state.usage.input_tokens)} in · ${fmtTokens(state.usage.output_tokens)} out`}
106	          title={`${state.usage.input_tokens} input / ${state.usage.output_tokens} output`}
107	        />
108	        <Stat label="elapsed" value={fmtDuration(elapsedMs(state))} />
109	        <Stat label="faults" value={`${recovered}/${faults} recovered`} />
110	        {state.evaluation ? (
111	          <Stat label="score" value={`${Math.round(state.evaluation.score)}`} />
112	        ) : null}
113	      </div>
114	
115	      <span className="flex-1" />
116	
117	      <Button
118	        variant="outline"
119	        size="sm"
120	        onClick={() => window.location.reload()}
121	        title="Reload and restore this run from GET /runs/{id}"
122	      >
123	        <RefreshCw aria-hidden /> Reload
124	      </Button>
125	    </header>
126	  )

156	function summarise(call: ToolCallView): string {
157	  if (call.command) return call.command
158	  if (call.path) return call.path
159	  const keys = Object.keys(call.input)
160	  if (keys.length === 0) return '(no input)'

164	function ResultBody({ result }: { result: ToolResultView }) {
165	  const parts: { label: string; body: string }[] = []
166	  if (result.errorText) parts.push({ label: result.errorCode ?? 'error', body: result.errorText })
167	  if (result.stdout) parts.push({ label: 'stdout', body: result.stdout })
168	  if (result.stderr) parts.push({ label: 'stderr', body: result.stderr })
169	  if (result.content !== null) parts.push({ label: 'content', body: result.content })
170	  if (result.entries) {
171	    parts.push({
172	      label: 'entries',
173	      body: result.entries.map((e) => `${e.type === 'dir' ? 'd' : '-'} ${e.name}`).join('\n'),
174	    })
175	  }
176	  if (result.bytesWritten !== null) {
177	    parts.push({ label: 'write', body: `${result.bytesWritten} bytes written` })
178	  }
179	  if (parts.length === 0 && result.output) parts.push({ label: 'output', body: result.output })
180	
181	  return (
182	    <div className="space-y-1.5">
183	      {parts.map((p) => (
184	        <div key={p.label}>
185	          <div className="mb-0.5 font-mono text-[10px] tracking-wide text-muted-foreground uppercase">
186	            {p.label}
187	          </div>
188	          <Mono>{p.body.length > 4000 ? `${p.body.slice(0, 4000)}\n…[truncated in view]` : p.body}</Mono>
189	        </div>
190	      ))}
191	      {result.truncated ? (

256	          {result ? <ResultBody result={result} /> : null}
257	        </div>
258	      ) : result ? (
259	        <div className="border-t border-border/60 px-3 py-2">
260	          <ResultBody result={result} />
261	        </div>
262	      ) : null}
263	    </div>
264	  )
265	}
266	
267	function StepBlock({ step, maxSteps }: { step: StepView; maxSteps: number }) {
268	  return (
269	    <section aria-label={`Step ${step.step}`} className="relative pl-8">
270	      <div className="absolute top-1 left-0 flex size-6 items-center justify-center rounded-full border border-border bg-card font-mono text-[11px] text-muted-foreground tabular-nums">
271	        {step.step}
272	      </div>
273	      <div className="space-y-2 pb-5">
274	        {step.texts.map((t, i) => (
275	          <p
276	            key={`${step.step}-t-${i}`}
277	            className="text-[13px] leading-relaxed whitespace-pre-wrap text-foreground/90"
278	          >
279	            {t}
280	          </p>
281	        ))}
282	        {step.calls.map((c) => (
283	          <CallCard key={c.toolUseId} call={c} />
284	        ))}
285	        {step.texts.length === 0 && step.calls.length === 0 ? (
286	          <p className="text-[13px] text-muted-foreground">
287	            step {step.step} of {maxSteps}
288	          </p>
289	        ) : null}
290	      </div>
291	    </section>
292	  )
293	}
294	
295	export function Timeline({ state, live }: { state: ViewState; live: boolean }) {
296	  const ref = useRef<HTMLDivElement | null>(null)
297	  const stick = useRef(true)
298	
299	  useEffect(() => {
300	    const el = ref.current
301	    if (!el) return
302	    const onScroll = () => {
303	      stick.current = el.scrollHeight - el.scrollTop - el.clientHeight < 80
304	    }
305	    el.addEventListener('scroll', onScroll, { passive: true })
306	    return () => el.removeEventListener('scroll', onScroll)
307	  }, [])
308	
309	  useEffect(() => {
310	    const el = ref.current
311	    if (!el || !live || !stick.current) return
312	    el.scrollTop = el.scrollHeight
313	  }, [state.eventCount, live])
314	
315	  if (state.steps.length === 0) {
316	    return (
317	      <div ref={ref} className="h-full overflow-y-auto p-6">
318	        <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
319	          {live ? 'Waiting for the first step…' : 'No steps recorded.'}
320	        </p>
321	      </div>
322	    )
323	  }
324	
325	  return (
326	    <div ref={ref} className="h-full overflow-y-auto px-4 py-4" tabIndex={0} aria-label="Run timeline">
327	      {state.taskPrompt ? (
328	        <div className="mb-5 rounded-lg border border-border bg-card/40 p-3">
329	          <div className="mb-1 flex items-center gap-1.5 text-[10px] tracking-wide text-muted-foreground uppercase">
330	            <CornerDownRight className="size-3" aria-hidden /> task
331	          </div>
332	          <p className="text-[13px] leading-relaxed whitespace-pre-wrap text-foreground/80">
333	            {state.taskPrompt}
334	          </p>
335	        </div>
336	      ) : null}
337	      <div className="relative">
338	        <div className="absolute top-2 bottom-2 left-3 w-px bg-border" aria-hidden />
339	        {state.steps.map((s) => (
340	          <StepBlock key={s.step} step={s} maxSteps={state.maxSteps} />
341	        ))}
342	      </div>
343	    </div>
344	  )
345	}

360	function DiffLine({ line }: { line: string }) {
361	  let tone = 'text-foreground/70'
362	  if (line.startsWith('+++') || line.startsWith('---')) tone = 'text-muted-foreground'
363	  else if (line.startsWith('@@')) tone = 'text-sky-300'
364	  else if (line.startsWith('+')) tone = 'bg-emerald-500/10 text-emerald-300'
365	  else if (line.startsWith('-')) tone = 'bg-rose-500/10 text-rose-300'
366	  return <div className={`px-2 ${tone}`}>{line === '' ? ' ' : line}</div>
367	}

781	import { useEffect, useMemo, useState } from 'react'
782	
783	import { Badge } from '@/components/ui/badge'
784	import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button'
785	import { subscribeLogs } from '@/lib/log'
786	import type { ViewState } from '@/lib/reducer'
787	import type { LogLevel, LogLine } from '@/lib/types'
788	
789	const LEVELS: (LogLevel | 'all')[] = ['all', 'debug', 'info', 'warn', 'error']
790	const RANK: Record<LogLevel, number> = { debug: 10, info: 20, warn: 30, error: 40 }
791	
792	const LVL_TONE: Record<LogLevel, string> = {
793	  debug: 'text-muted-foreground',
794	  info: 'text-sky-300',
795	  warn: 'text-amber-300',
796	  error: 'text-rose-300',
797	}
798	
799	function renderExtras(line: LogLine): string {
800	  const skip = new Set(['ts', 'svc', 'lvl', 'ev', 'msg', '_seq'])
801	  const parts: string[] = []
802	  for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(line)) {
803	    if (skip.has(k) || v === null || v === undefined) continue
804	    parts.push(`${k}=${typeof v === 'string' ? v : JSON.stringify(v)}`)
805	  }
806	  return parts.join(' ')
807	}
808	
809	export function LogsPanel({ state }: { state: ViewState }) {
810	  const [level, setLevel] = useState<LogLevel | 'all'>('all')
811	  const [raw, setRaw] = useState(false)
812	  const [webLines, setWebLines] = useState<LogLine[]>([])
813

import * as React from "react"

const MOBILE_BREAKPOINT = 768

export function useIsMobile() {
  const [isMobile, setIsMobile] = React.useState<boolean | undefined>(undefined)

  React.useEffect(() => {
    const mql = window.matchMedia(`(max-width: ${MOBILE_BREAKPOINT - 1}px)`)
    const onChange = () => {
      setIsMobile(window.innerWidth < MOBILE_BREAKPOINT)
    }
    mql.addEventListener("change", onChange)
    setIsMobile(window.innerWidth < MOBILE_BREAKPOINT)
    return () => mql.removeEventListener("change", onChange)
  }, [])

  return !!isMobile
}

import type { MouseEvent } from 'react'

import { hrefFor, navigate, type Route } from '@/lib/router'

/**
 * Props for an `<a>` that navigates in-app on a plain left click and behaves like a normal link
 * otherwise (middle click, cmd/ctrl click, right click → open in a new tab / copy link).
 */
export function linkProps(route: Route, opts: { replace?: boolean } = {}) {
  return {
    href: hrefFor(route),
    onClick: (e: MouseEvent<HTMLAnchorElement>) => {
      if (e.defaultPrevented || e.button !== 0) return
      if (e.metaKey || e.ctrlKey || e.shiftKey || e.altKey) return
      e.preventDefault()
      navigate(route, opts)
    },
  }
}
EOF

import { useEffect, useState } from 'react'
import { Database, Radio, Rewind } from 'lucide-react'

import { Badge } from '@/components/ui/badge'
import { Tooltip, TooltipContent, TooltipTrigger } from '@/components/ui/tooltip'
import type { TransportState } from '@/lib/api'
import { fmtDuration, fmtTokens } from '@/lib/format'
import { elapsedMs, faultCount, recoveredCount, type ViewState } from '@/lib/reducer'
import type { RunStatus } from '@/lib/types'

export const STATUS_TONE: Record<RunStatus, string> = {
  queued: 'border-border text-muted-foreground',
  running: 'border-sky-500/30 bg-sky-500/10 text-sky-300',
  ok: 'border-emerald-500/30 bg-emerald-500/10 text-emerald-300',
  error: 'border-rose-500/30 bg-rose-500/10 text-rose-300',
  truncated: 'border-amber-500/30 bg-amber-500/10 text-amber-300',
}

/** Where the transcript on screen is coming from. Shown so a reviewer can see the persistence path. */
export type TranscriptSource = 'sse' | 'poll' | 'sqlite' | 'replay' | 'record'

const SOURCE_LABEL: Record<TranscriptSource, { label: string; tip: string; icon: typeof Radio }> = {
  sse: { label: 'live · sse', tip: 'Tailing GET /runs/{id}/events; the harness rotates the stream every ~110 s and we resume with Last-Event-ID.', icon: Radio },
  poll: { label: 'live · poll', tip: 'SSE failed twice in a row — polling GET /runs/{id} every 1.5 s instead.', icon: Radio },
  sqlite: { label: 'sqlite', tip: 'Transcript loaded from GET /conversations/{id}: the messages/blocks projection stored in SQLite on the Modal Volume.', icon: Database },
  record: { label: 'record', tip: 'Loaded from GET /runs/{id} (the persisted run record).', icon: Database },
  replay: { label: 'replay', tip: 'A bundled recorded run playing back in the browser; no backend involved.', icon: Rewind },
}

function Stat({ label, value, title }: { label: string; value: string; title?: string }) {
  return (
    <div className="hidden flex-col leading-tight lg:flex" title={title}>
      <span className="text-[10px] tracking-wide text-muted-foreground uppercase">{label}</span>
      <span className="font-mono text-[11px] tabular-nums">{value}</span>
    </div>
  )
}

export function RunStatusStrip({
  state,
  transport,
  source,
  replaying,
}: {
  state: ViewState | null
  transport: TransportState | null
  source: TranscriptSource | null
  replaying?: boolean
}) {
  const live = !!state && (state.status === 'running' || state.status === 'queued')
  const [, setTick] = useState(0)
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!live) return
    const t = setInterval(() => setTick((n) => n + 1), 1000)
    return () => clearInterval(t)
  }, [live])

  if (!state) return null
  const faults = faultCount(state)
  const recovered = recoveredCount(state)
  const src = source ? SOURCE_LABEL[source] : null
  const SrcIcon = src?.icon ?? Radio

  return (
    <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
      <Badge variant="outline" className={`font-mono ${STATUS_TONE[state.status]}`}>
        {replaying ? 'replay' : state.status}
      </Badge>
      {src ? (
        <Tooltip>
          <TooltipTrigger
            render={
              <Badge variant="outline" className="font-mono text-muted-foreground">
                <SrcIcon aria-hidden /> {src.label}
              </Badge>
            }
          />
          <TooltipContent>{src.tip}{transport?.detail ? ` (${transport.detail})` : ''}</TooltipContent>
        </Tooltip>
      ) : null}
      <Stat label="step" value={`${state.step}/${state.maxSteps}`} />
      <Stat
        label="tokens"
        value={`${fmtTokens(state.usage.input_tokens)} in · ${fmtTokens(state.usage.output_tokens)} out`}
        title={`${state.usage.input_tokens} input / ${state.usage.output_tokens} output`}
      />
      <Stat label="elapsed" value={fmtDuration(elapsedMs(state))} />
      <Stat label="faults" value={`${recovered}/${faults} recovered`} />
      {state.evaluation ? <Stat label="score" value={`${Math.round(state.evaluation.score)}`} /> : null}
    </div>
  )
}
EOF

import { useMemo, useState } from 'react'
import {
  Check,
  Copy,
  FileX2,
  GitBranchPlus,
  Lock,
  MessageSquare,
  Plus,
  RotateCcw,
  Rewind,
  ShieldCheck,
  Timer,
  Zap,
} from 'lucide-react'

import { linkProps } from '@/components/layout/Link'
import { Avatar, AvatarFallback } from '@/components/ui/avatar'
import {
  DropdownMenu,
  DropdownMenuContent,
  DropdownMenuItem,
  DropdownMenuLabel,
  DropdownMenuSeparator,
  DropdownMenuTrigger,
} from '@/components/ui/dropdown-menu'
import {
  Sidebar,
  SidebarContent,
  SidebarFooter,
  SidebarGroup,
  SidebarGroupContent,
  SidebarGroupLabel,
  SidebarHeader,
  SidebarMenu,
  SidebarMenuBadge,
  SidebarMenuButton,
  SidebarMenuItem,
  SidebarMenuSkeleton,
  SidebarRail,
} from '@/components/ui/sidebar'
import type { ConversationsState } from '@/hooks/useConversations'
import type { HarnessState } from '@/hooks/useHarness'
import { getLogger } from '@/lib/log'
import { DEMOS } from '@/lib/replay'
import type { Route } from '@/lib/router'
import type { ConversationSummary, RunStatus } from '@/lib/types'

const log = getLogger('web')

const SCENARIO_ICON: Record<string, typeof MessageSquare> = {
  'missing-config': FileX2,
  'locked-file': Lock,
  'lost-ack': Timer,
  gauntlet: Zap,
}

const STATUS_DOT: Record<RunStatus, string> = {
  queued: 'bg-muted-foreground/60',
  running: 'bg-sky-400 animate-pulse',
  ok: 'bg-emerald-400',
  error: 'bg-rose-400',
  truncated: 'bg-amber-400',
}

function dayBucket(iso: string, now = new Date()): string {
  const d = new Date(iso)
  if (Number.isNaN(d.getTime())) return 'Earlier'
  const startOfToday = new Date(now.getFullYear(), now.getMonth(), now.getDate()).getTime()
  const t = d.getTime()
  if (t >= startOfToday) return 'Today'
  if (t >= startOfToday - 86_400_000) return 'Yesterday'
  if (t >= startOfToday - 6 * 86_400_000) return 'Previous 7 days'
  return 'Earlier'
}

function groupByDay(items: ConversationSummary[]): { label: string; items: ConversationSummary[] }[] {
  const order = ['Today', 'Yesterday', 'Previous 7 days', 'Earlier']
  const buckets = new Map<string, ConversationSummary[]>()
  for (const c of items) {
    const key = dayBucket(c.updated_at || c.created_at)
    const arr = buckets.get(key) ?? []
    arr.push(c)
    buckets.set(key, arr)
  }
  return order.filter((k) => buckets.has(k)).map((k) => ({ label: k, items: buckets.get(k)! }))
}

function shortId(userId: string | null): string {
  if (!userId) return '—'
  return userId.length > 12 ? `${userId.slice(0, 10)}…` : userId
}

function ConversationRow({ c, active }: { c: ConversationSummary; active: boolean }) {
  const Icon = SCENARIO_ICON[c.scenario_id] ?? MessageSquare
  const status = c.last_run?.status ?? null
  const route: Route = { kind: 'conversation', id: c.id }
  return (
    <SidebarMenuItem>
      <SidebarMenuButton
        isActive={active}
        tooltip={c.title}
        render={<a {...linkProps(route)} />}
        className="group/row"
      >
        <Icon aria-hidden className="text-muted-foreground" />
        <span className="truncate">{c.title}</span>
      </SidebarMenuButton>
      {status ? (
        <SidebarMenuBadge className="gap-1.5 font-mono text-[10px] text-muted-foreground">
          {c.last_run?.score !== null && c.last_run?.score !== undefined
            ? Math.round(c.last_run.score)
            : ''}
          <span
            aria-label={`last run ${status}`}
            className={`inline-block size-1.5 rounded-full ${STATUS_DOT[status]}`}
          />
        </SidebarMenuBadge>
      ) : null}
    </SidebarMenuItem>
  )
}

export function AppSidebar({
  harness,
  conversations,
  route,
}: {
  harness: HarnessState
  conversations: ConversationsState
  route: Route
}) {
  const [copied, setCopied] = useState(false)
  const groups = useMemo(() => groupByDay(conversations.items), [conversations.items])
  const activeConversation = route.kind === 'conversation' ? route.id : null
  const activeReplay = route.kind === 'replay' ? route.demoId : null
  const userId = harness.userId ?? null

  const copyId = async () => {
    if (!userId) return
    try {
      await navigator.clipboard.writeText(userId)
      setCopied(true)
      setTimeout(() => setCopied(false), 1500)
    } catch (err) {
      log.warn('identity.copy_failed', 'clipboard unavailable', { error: String(err) })
    }
  }

import { useEffect, useRef } from 'react'
import { AlertTriangle, CornerDownRight, OctagonAlert } from 'lucide-react'

import { AssistantText, LoadingState, ScoreRows, ThinkingTrace, ToolCallChips } from '@/components/bui'
import type { TransportState } from '@/lib/api'
import type { Transcript, Turn } from '@/lib/transcript'
import type { FileDiff } from '@/lib/types'

function UserBubble({ text }: { text: string }) {
  return (
    <div className="flex justify-end" aria-label="Task prompt">
      <div className="max-w-[85%] rounded-2xl rounded-br-md border border-line bg-surface px-4 py-3">
        <div className="mb-1 flex items-center gap-1.5 text-[10px] tracking-wide text-ink-3 uppercase">
          <CornerDownRight className="size-3" aria-hidden /> task
        </div>
        <p className="text-[13.5px] leading-relaxed whitespace-pre-wrap text-ink">{text}</p>
      </div>
    </div>
  )
}

function Callout({
  tone,
  title,
  body,
}: {
  tone: 'error' | 'warn'
  title: string
  body?: string | null
}) {
  const cls =
    tone === 'error'
      ? 'border-rose-500/30 bg-rose-500/10 text-rose-200'
      : 'border-amber-500/30 bg-amber-500/10 text-amber-200'
  const Icon = tone === 'error' ? OctagonAlert : AlertTriangle
  return (
    <div role="status" className={`flex items-start gap-2 rounded-xl border px-3 py-2.5 text-[13px] ${cls}`}>
      <Icon className="mt-0.5 size-4 shrink-0" aria-hidden />
      <div className="min-w-0">
        <div className="font-medium">{title}</div>
        {body ? <div className="mt-0.5 font-mono text-[11.5px] break-words opacity-80">{body}</div> : null}
      </div>
    </div>
  )
}

function TurnBlock({
  turn,
  isLast,
  live,
  maxSteps,
  diffs,
}: {
  turn: Turn
  isLast: boolean
  live: boolean
  maxSteps: number
  diffs: FileDiff[]
}) {
  const pending = turn.calls.some((c) => c.result === null)
  const active = live && isLast && pending
  const done = !live || !isLast || (!pending && turn.calls.length > 0)
  return (
    <section aria-label={`Step ${turn.step}`} className="space-y-3">
      {turn.texts.map((t, i) => (
        <AssistantText
          key={`${turn.step}-t-${i}`}
          text={t}
          streaming={live && isLast && i === turn.texts.length - 1 && turn.calls.length === 0}
        />
      ))}
      {turn.calls.length > 0 || turn.thinking ? (
        <ThinkingTrace
          step={turn.step}
          maxSteps={maxSteps}
          calls={turn.calls}
          thinking={turn.thinking}
          active={active}
          done={done}
          defaultOpen={isLast}
        >
          <ToolCallChips calls={turn.calls} diffs={diffs} live={live && isLast} />
        </ThinkingTrace>
      ) : null}
    </section>
  )
}

export function TranscriptView({
  transcript,
  diffs,
  maxSteps,
  loading,
  loadingLabel,
  error,
  transport,
  footer,
}: {
  transcript: Transcript
  diffs: FileDiff[]
  maxSteps: number
  loading?: boolean
  loadingLabel?: string
  error?: string | null
  transport?: TransportState | null
  /** Rendered below the transcript inside the same scroll container (run switcher, composer spacer). */
  footer?: React.ReactNode
}) {
  const ref = useRef<HTMLDivElement | null>(null)
  const stick = useRef(true)
  const live = transcript.live

  useEffect(() => {
    const el = ref.current
    if (!el) return
    const onScroll = () => {
      stick.current = el.scrollHeight - el.scrollTop - el.clientHeight < 96
    }
    el.addEventListener('scroll', onScroll, { passive: true })
    return () => el.removeEventListener('scroll', onScroll)
  }, [])

  const turnCount = transcript.turns.length
  const callCount = transcript.turns.reduce((n, t) => n + t.calls.length, 0)
  useEffect(() => {
    const el = ref.current
    if (!el || !live || !stick.current) return
    el.scrollTop = el.scrollHeight
  }, [turnCount, callCount, live, transcript.evaluation])

  const last = transcript.turns[transcript.turns.length - 1]
  const waitingOnModel =
    live && (!last || (last.calls.length > 0 && last.calls.every((c) => c.result !== null)))

  return (
    <div ref={ref} className="min-h-0 flex-1 overflow-y-auto" tabIndex={0} aria-label="Transcript">
      <div className="mx-auto w-full max-w-3xl space-y-6 px-4 py-6 md:px-6">
        {loading ? (
          <LoadingState label={loadingLabel ?? 'Loading…'} />
        ) : null}

        {error && turnCount === 0 && !loading ? (
          <Callout tone="warn" title="Could not load this run" body={error} />
        ) : null}

        {transcript.taskPrompt ? <UserBubble text={transcript.taskPrompt} /> : null}

        {transcript.turns.map((t, i) => (
          <TurnBlock
            key={t.step}
            turn={t}
            isLast={i === transcript.turns.length - 1}
            live={live}
            maxSteps={maxSteps}
            diffs={diffs}
          />
        ))}

        {live && turnCount === 0 && !loading ? (
          <LoadingState
            label={transcript.status === 'queued' ? 'Queued — provisioning the sandbox…' : 'Provisioning the sandbox…'}
            sublabel="creating a Modal Sandbox, copying the fixture repo, applying the fault plan"
          />
        ) : null}
        {waitingOnModel && turnCount > 0 ? (
          <LoadingState label="Waiting on the model…" sublabel={transcript.model ?? undefined} />
        ) : null}

        {transcript.evaluation ? <ScoreRows evaluation={transcript.evaluation} /> : null}

        {transcript.status === 'error' ? (
          <Callout tone="error" title="The run ended with an error" body={transcript.error ?? null} />
        ) : null}
        {transcript.status === 'truncated' ? (
          <Callout
            tone="warn"
            title={`Step budget exhausted (${maxSteps} steps)`}
            body="The agent did not submit in time; whatever it left on disk was still graded."
          />
        ) : null}
        {transport?.mode === 'poll' ? (
          <p className="text-center text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">
            live stream unavailable — polling the run record every 1.5 s
          </p>
        ) : null}
        {footer}
      </div>
    </div>
  )
}

import { useMemo, useState } from 'react'

import { CodeBlock, FileStatusTable } from '@/components/bui'
import { LogsPanel } from '@/components/LogsPanel'
import { Timeline } from '@/components/Timeline'
import { Badge } from '@/components/ui/badge'
import { Sheet, SheetContent, SheetDescription, SheetHeader, SheetTitle } from '@/components/ui/sheet'
import { Tabs, TabsContent, TabsList, TabsTrigger } from '@/components/ui/tabs'
import type { ViewState } from '@/lib/reducer'

export function WorkspaceTabs({ state, live }: { state: ViewState | null; live: boolean }) {
  const [selected, setSelected] = useState<string | null>(null)
  const [tab, setTab] = useState('files')
  const files = state?.files ?? []
  const diffs = state?.diffs ?? []
  const changed = useMemo(() => files.filter((f) => f.status !== 'unchanged').length, [files])
  const ordered = useMemo(
    () => (selected ? [...diffs].sort((a, b) => (a.path === selected ? -1 : b.path === selected ? 1 : 0)) : diffs),
    [diffs, selected],
  )

  return (
    <Tabs value={tab} onValueChange={(v) => setTab(String(v))} className="flex min-h-0 flex-1 flex-col gap-0">
      <div className="flex items-center gap-3 border-b border-border px-3 py-2">
        <TabsList variant="line">
          <TabsTrigger value="files">Files</TabsTrigger>
          <TabsTrigger value="diffs">Diffs</TabsTrigger>
          <TabsTrigger value="timeline">Timeline</TabsTrigger>
          <TabsTrigger value="logs">Logs</TabsTrigger>
        </TabsList>
        <span className="flex-1" />
        {files.length > 0 ? (
          <Badge variant="outline" className="font-mono text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">
            {changed} changed
          </Badge>
        ) : null}
      </div>
      <TabsContent value="files" className="min-h-0 flex-1 overflow-y-auto p-3">
        {files.length === 0 ? (
          <p className="p-2 text-sm text-muted-foreground">
            No workspace snapshot yet — it arrives with the first mutating step.
          </p>
        ) : (
          <FileStatusTable
            files={files}
            selected={selected}
            onSelect={(p) => {
              setSelected(p)
              if (diffs.some((d) => d.path === p)) setTab('diffs')
            }}
          />
        )}
      </TabsContent>
      <TabsContent value="diffs" className="min-h-0 flex-1 space-y-3 overflow-y-auto p-3">
        {ordered.length === 0 ? (
          <p className="p-2 text-sm text-muted-foreground">Nothing has changed on disk yet.</p>
        ) : (
          ordered.map((d) => <CodeBlock key={d.path} diff={d.unified} filename={d.path} />)
        )}
      </TabsContent>
      <TabsContent value="timeline" className="min-h-0 flex-1 overflow-hidden">
        {state ? <Timeline state={state} live={live} /> : null}
      </TabsContent>
      <TabsContent value="logs" className="min-h-0 flex-1 overflow-hidden">
        {state ? <LogsPanel state={state} /> : null}
      </TabsContent>
    </Tabs>
  )
}

/** Desktop: a right-hand column. Narrow screens: a sheet. Both render the same tabs. */
export function WorkspacePanel({
  state,
  live,
  open,
  onOpenChange,
}: {
  state: ViewState | null
  live: boolean
  open: boolean
  onOpenChange: (open: boolean) => void
}) {
  return (
    <>
      {open ? (
        <aside className="hidden w-[440px] shrink-0 flex-col border-l border-border bg-card/30 xl:flex">
          <WorkspaceTabs state={state} live={live} />
        </aside>
      ) : null}
      <div className="xl:hidden">
        <Sheet open={open} onOpenChange={onOpenChange}>
          <SheetContent side="right" className="flex w-[92vw] flex-col gap-0 p-0 sm:max-w-[520px]">
            <SheetHeader className="border-b border-border px-4 py-3">
              <SheetTitle>Workspace</SheetTitle>
              <SheetDescription>Files, diffs, raw timeline and logs for this run.</SheetDescription>
            </SheetHeader>
            <WorkspaceTabs state={state} live={live} />
          </SheetContent>
        </Sheet>
      </div>
    </>
  )
}

import { useCallback, useState } from 'react'

import type { ConversationsState } from '@/hooks/useConversations'
import type { HarnessState } from '@/hooks/useHarness'
import { isNotFound } from '@/lib/api'
import { getLogger } from '@/lib/log'
import { navigate } from '@/lib/router'

const log = getLogger('web')

export interface StartParams {
  scenarioId: string
  model: string
  seed: number | null
  /** Task prompt override; empty/null = the scenario default (server side). */
  prompt: string | null
  /** Start the run inside an existing conversation. */
  conversationId?: string | null
  title?: string
}

/**
 * One place that knows how to start a run, in order of preference:
 *   1. inside an existing conversation          → POST /conversations/{id}/runs
 *   2. new conversation (history available)     → POST /conversations, then (1)
 *   3. harness without the SQLite store (404)   → POST /runs, land on /runs/{id}
 * and then navigates to the right page. Every path refreshes the conversation rail.
 */
export function useStartRun(harness: HarnessState, conversations: ConversationsState) {
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false)
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null)

  const start = useCallback(
    async (p: StartParams): Promise<string | null> => {
      const client = harness.client
      if (!client) {
        setError('harness URL not resolved yet')
        return null
      }
      setBusy(true)
      setError(null)
      const req = {
        model: p.model,
        seed: p.seed,
        task_prompt: p.prompt && p.prompt.trim() ? p.prompt : undefined,
      }
      try {
        if (p.conversationId) {
          const r = await client.createConversationRun(p.conversationId, req)
          log.info('run.started', 'run accepted (existing conversation)', {
            run_id: r.run_id,
            conversation_id: p.conversationId,
            scenario_id: p.scenarioId,
            model: p.model,
          })
          navigate({ kind: 'conversation', id: r.conversation_id ?? p.conversationId, runId: r.run_id })
          conversations.refresh()
          return r.run_id
        }

        if (conversations.available !== false) {
          try {
            const conv = await client.createConversation({ scenario_id: p.scenarioId, title: p.title })
            const r = await client.createConversationRun(conv.id, req)
            log.info('run.started', 'run accepted (new conversation)', {
              run_id: r.run_id,
              conversation_id: conv.id,
              scenario_id: p.scenarioId,
              model: p.model,
            })
            navigate({ kind: 'conversation', id: conv.id, runId: r.run_id })
            conversations.refresh()
            return r.run_id
          } catch (err) {
            if (!isNotFound(err)) throw err
            log.warn('conversations.unavailable', 'no /conversations routes on this harness; using POST /runs', {
              error: String(err),
            })
          }
        }

        const r = await client.createRun({ scenario_id: p.scenarioId, model: p.model, seed: p.seed })
        log.info('run.started', 'run accepted (POST /runs)', {
          run_id: r.run_id,
          conversation_id: r.conversation_id ?? null,
          scenario_id: p.scenarioId,
          model: p.model,
        })
        if (r.conversation_id) navigate({ kind: 'conversation', id: r.conversation_id, runId: r.run_id })
        else navigate({ kind: 'run', runId: r.run_id })
        conversations.refresh()
        return r.run_id
      } catch (err) {
        setError(String(err))
        log.error('run.start_failed', 'could not start the run', {
          scenario_id: p.scenarioId,
          error: String(err),
        })
        return null
      } finally {
        setBusy(false)
      }
    },
    [harness.client, conversations],
  )

  return { start, busy, error }
}

import { useEffect, useMemo, useState } from 'react'
import { AlertTriangle } from 'lucide-react'

import { Composer } from '@/components/bui'
import { HealthBanner } from '@/components/HealthBanner'
import { TopBar } from '@/components/layout/TopBar'
import { ScenarioGrid, ScenarioSkeletons } from '@/components/ScenarioGrid'
import type { ConversationsState } from '@/hooks/useConversations'
import type { HarnessState } from '@/hooks/useHarness'
import { useStartRun } from '@/hooks/useStartRun'
import { navigate } from '@/lib/router'
import { DEFAULT_MODEL, MODEL_ALLOWLIST, type Scenario } from '@/lib/types'

export function HomePage({
  harness,
  conversations,
}: {
  harness: HarnessState
  conversations: ConversationsState
}) {
  const [scenarioId, setScenarioId] = useState<string | null>(null)
  const [model, setModel] = useState<string>(DEFAULT_MODEL)
  const [seed, setSeed] = useState<number | null>(null)
  const [prompt, setPrompt] = useState('')
  const { start, busy, error } = useStartRun(harness, conversations)

  useEffect(() => {
    if (harness.health?.model_default) setModel(harness.health.model_default)
  }, [harness.health?.model_default])

  useEffect(() => {
    document.title = 'Faultline — new run'
  }, [])

  const scenario = useMemo(
    () => harness.scenarios.find((s) => s.id === scenarioId) ?? null,
    [harness.scenarios, scenarioId],
  )

  const pick = (id: string) => {
    setScenarioId(id)
    const s = harness.scenarios.find((x) => x.id === id)
    if (s) setPrompt(s.task_prompt)
  }

  const submit = () => {
    if (!scenario || busy) return
    void start({
      scenarioId: scenario.id,
      model,
      seed,
      prompt: prompt.trim() === scenario.task_prompt.trim() ? null : prompt,
      title: scenario.title,
    })
  }

  const runScenario = (s: Scenario) => {
    setScenarioId(s.id)
    setPrompt(s.task_prompt)
    void start({ scenarioId: s.id, model, seed, prompt: null, title: s.title })
  }

  const canRun = harness.reachable && !!harness.client
  const hint = !harness.client
    ? 'resolving the harness URL…'
    : !harness.reachable
      ? 'harness unreachable — bundled replays still work from the sidebar'
      : scenario
        ? `${scenario.title} · max ${scenario.max_steps} steps · enter to run`
        : 'type / to pick a scenario, or use a card below'

  return (
    <div className="flex h-dvh min-h-0 flex-col">
      <TopBar crumbs={[{ label: 'New run' }]} />
      <div className="min-h-0 flex-1 overflow-y-auto">
        <div className="mx-auto w-full max-w-3xl space-y-8 px-4 py-8 md:px-6">

            <h1 className="text-2xl font-medium tracking-tight">Run a Claude agent through a failing sandbox</h1>

                starting={busy && scenarioId ? scenarioId : null}

                onRun={runScenario}

                No scenarios from the harness
                {harness.scenariosError ? ` (${harness.scenariosError})` : ''}. The bundled replays in the
                sidebar still work offline.
              </div>
            )}
          </section>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  )
}

import { useEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState } from 'react'
import { AlertTriangle } from 'lucide-react'

import { Composer } from '@/components/bui'
import { linkProps } from '@/components/layout/Link'
import { RunStatusStrip, STATUS_TONE, type TranscriptSource } from '@/components/layout/RunStatusStrip'
import { TopBar } from '@/components/layout/TopBar'
import { TranscriptView } from '@/components/transcript/TranscriptView'
import { WorkspacePanel } from '@/components/workspace/WorkspaceColumn'
import { Badge } from '@/components/ui/badge'
import { Skeleton } from '@/components/ui/skeleton'
import { useConversation } from '@/hooks/useConversation'
import type { ConversationsState } from '@/hooks/useConversations'
import type { HarnessState } from '@/hooks/useHarness'
import { useRunView } from '@/hooks/useRunView'
import { useStartRun } from '@/hooks/useStartRun'
import { getLogger } from '@/lib/log'
import { isTerminal } from '@/lib/reducer'
import { navigate } from '@/lib/router'
import { transcriptFromMessages, transcriptFromViewState } from '@/lib/transcript'
import { DEFAULT_MODEL, MODEL_ALLOWLIST, type RunSummary } from '@/lib/types'

const log = getLogger('web')

function RunSwitcher({
  conversationId,
  runs,
  selectedId,
}: {
  conversationId: string
  runs: RunSummary[]
  selectedId: string | null
}) {
  if (runs.length <= 1) return null
  return (
    <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-1.5" aria-label="Runs in this conversation">
      <span className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">runs</span>
      {runs.map((r, i) => (
        <a
          key={r.id}
          {...linkProps({ kind: 'conversation', id: conversationId, runId: r.id })}
          aria-current={r.id === selectedId ? 'page' : undefined}
          className="rounded-md outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring/50"
        >
          <Badge
            variant="outline"
            className={`font-mono ${STATUS_TONE[r.status]} ${r.id === selectedId ? 'ring-1 ring-ring/60' : 'opacity-80'}`}
          >
            #{i + 1} · {r.status}
            {r.score !== null && r.score !== undefined ? ` · ${Math.round(r.score)}` : ''}
          </Badge>
        </a>
      ))}
    </div>
  )
}

export function ConversationPage({
  harness,
  conversations,
  conversationId,
  runId,
}: {
  harness: HarnessState
  conversations: ConversationsState
  conversationId: string
  runId: string | null
}) {
  const { detail, loading, error, refresh } = useConversation(harness.client, conversationId)
  const [workspaceOpen, setWorkspaceOpen] = useState(true)
  const [model, setModel] = useState<string>(DEFAULT_MODEL)
  const [seed, setSeed] = useState<number | null>(null)
  const [prompt, setPrompt] = useState('')
  const { start, busy, error: startError } = useStartRun(harness, conversations)

  const runs = useMemo(
    () => [...(detail?.runs ?? [])].sort((a, b) => a.created_at.localeCompare(b.created_at)),
    [detail?.runs],
  )
  const selected: RunSummary | null = useMemo(() => {
    if (runs.length === 0) return null
    return (runId ? runs.find((r) => r.id === runId) : null) ?? runs[runs.length - 1] ?? null
  }, [runs, runId])

  const source = useMemo(
    () => (selected ? ({ kind: 'live', runId: selected.id } as const) : ({ kind: 'none' } as const)),
    [selected],
  )
  const rv = useRunView(harness.client, source)
  const live = !!selected && (rv.state.status === 'running' || rv.state.status === 'queued')

  // When the live run reaches a terminal state, reload the conversation from the store so the
  // transcript switches to the persisted (SQLite) projection and the rail updates its status dot.
  const refreshedFor = useRef<string | null>(null)
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!selected || !isTerminal(rv.state.status) || rv.state.runId !== selected.id) return
    if (refreshedFor.current === selected.id) return
    refreshedFor.current = selected.id
    if (!isTerminal(selected.status)) {
      log.info('conversation.refresh', 'run finished; reloading persisted transcript', {
        conversation_id: conversationId,
        run_id: selected.id,
        status: rv.state.status,
      })
      refresh()
      conversations.refresh()
    }
  }, [rv.state.status, rv.state.runId, selected, conversationId, refresh, conversations])

  useEffect(() => {
    if (harness.health?.model_default) setModel(harness.health.model_default)
  }, [harness.health?.model_default])

  const scenario = useMemo(
    () => harness.scenarios.find((s) => s.id === detail?.conversation.scenario_id) ?? null,
    [harness.scenarios, detail?.conversation.scenario_id],
  )
  useEffect(() => {
    if (scenario && prompt === '') setPrompt(scenario.task_prompt)
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, [scenario?.id])

  useEffect(() => {
    document.title = detail ? `${detail.conversation.title} — Faultline` : 'Faultline'
  }, [detail])

  const messagesForRun = useMemo(
    () => (detail && selected ? detail.messages.filter((m) => m.run_id === selected.id) : []),
    [detail, selected],
  )
  const persisted = !!detail && !!selected && isTerminal(selected.status) && messagesForRun.length > 0 && !live
  const transcript = useMemo(
    () =>
      persisted && detail && selected
        ? transcriptFromMessages(messagesForRun, selected)
        : transcriptFromViewState(rv.state, live),
    [persisted, detail, selected, messagesForRun, rv.state, live],
  )
  const transcriptSource: TranscriptSource | null = persisted
    ? 'sqlite'
    : live
      ? rv.transport?.mode === 'poll'
        ? 'poll'
        : 'sse'
      : selected
        ? 'record'
        : null

  const submit = () => {
    if (!detail || busy) return
    void start({
      scenarioId: detail.conversation.scenario_id,
      model,
      seed,
      prompt: scenario && prompt.trim() === scenario.task_prompt.trim() ? null : prompt,
      conversationId: detail.conversation.id,
    })
  }

  const title = detail?.conversation.title ?? (loading ? 'Loading…' : 'Conversation')

  return (
    <div className="flex h-dvh min-h-0 flex-col">
      <TopBar
        crumbs={[{ label: 'Conversations', route: { kind: 'home' } }, { label: title }]}
        onToggleWorkspace={() => setWorkspaceOpen((v) => !v)}
        workspaceOpen={workspaceOpen}
      >
        <RunStatusStrip state={selected ? rv.state : null} transport={rv.transport} source={transcriptSource} />
      </TopBar>

      <div className="flex min-h-0 flex-1">
        <div className="flex min-h-0 min-w-0 flex-1 flex-col">
          {loading && !detail ? (
            <div className="mx-auto w-full max-w-3xl space-y-4 px-4 py-8">
              <Skeleton className="ml-auto h-16 w-2/3" />
              <Skeleton className="h-20 w-full" />
              <Skeleton className="h-32 w-full" />
            </div>
          ) : error && !detail ? (
            <div className="mx-auto w-full max-w-3xl px-4 py-8">
              <div className="flex items-start gap-2 rounded-lg border border-amber-500/30 bg-amber-500/10 px-3 py-2.5 text-[13px] text-amber-200">
                <AlertTriangle className="mt-0.5 size-4 shrink-0" aria-hidden />
                <div>
                  <div className="font-medium">Conversation not available</div>
                  <div className="mt-0.5 font-mono text-[11.5px] break-all opacity-80">{error}</div>
                  <a className="mt-1 inline-block underline" {...linkProps({ kind: 'home' })}>
                    Start a new run
                  </a>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
          ) : (
            <TranscriptView
              transcript={transcript}
              diffs={rv.state.diffs}
              maxSteps={rv.state.maxSteps || scenario?.max_steps || 20}
              loading={!!selected && rv.loading}
              loadingLabel="Loading run…"
              error={rv.loadError}
              transport={rv.transport}
              footer={
                <div className="space-y-3 pt-2">
                  {detail ? (
                    <RunSwitcher conversationId={detail.conversation.id} runs={runs} selectedId={selected?.id ?? null} />
                  ) : null}
                  {detail && runs.length === 0 ? (
                    <p className="text-[13px] text-muted-foreground">
                      No runs in this conversation yet — send the task below to start one.
                    </p>
                  ) : null}
                </div>
              }
            />
          )}

          {detail ? (
            <div className="shrink-0 border-t border-border bg-background/90 px-4 py-3 backdrop-blur md:px-6">
              <div className="mx-auto w-full max-w-3xl space-y-2">
                <Composer
                  scenarios={scenario ? [scenario] : harness.scenarios}
                  scenarioId={detail.conversation.scenario_id}
                  onScenarioChange={() => undefined}
                  models={MODEL_ALLOWLIST}
                  model={model}
                  onModelChange={setModel}
                  seed={seed}
                  onSeedChange={setSeed}
                  prompt={prompt}
                  onPromptChange={setPrompt}
                  onSubmit={submit}
                  disabled={!harness.reachable || live || busy}
                  busy={busy}
                  placeholder={live ? 'A run is in progress…' : 'Edit the task and press enter to run it again in this conversation'}
                  hint={
                    live
                      ? 'wait for the current run to finish'
                      : `${detail.conversation.scenario_id} · another run in this conversation`
                  }
                />
                {startError ? (
                  <div className="flex items-start gap-2 rounded-lg border border-destructive/40 bg-destructive/10 px-3 py-2 text-[13px] text-destructive">
                    <AlertTriangle className="mt-0.5 size-4 shrink-0" aria-hidden />
                    <span className="break-all">Could not start the run: {startError}</span>
                  </div>
                ) : null}
              </div>
            </div>
          ) : null}
        </div>

        <WorkspacePanel state={selected ? rv.state : null} live={live} open={workspaceOpen} onOpenChange={setWorkspaceOpen} />
      </div>
    </div>
  )
}

export function conversationRouteFor(conversationId: string, runId: string | null) {
  return runId ? { kind: 'conversation' as const, id: conversationId, runId } : { kind: 'conversation' as const, id: conversationId }
}

export { navigate }

import { useEffect, useMemo, useState } from 'react'

import { RunStatusStrip, type TranscriptSource } from '@/components/layout/RunStatusStrip'
import { TopBar } from '@/components/layout/TopBar'
import { TranscriptView } from '@/components/transcript/TranscriptView'
import { WorkspacePanel } from '@/components/workspace/WorkspaceColumn'
import type { HarnessState } from '@/hooks/useHarness'
import { useRunView } from '@/hooks/useRunView'
import { getLogger } from '@/lib/log'
import { navigate } from '@/lib/router'
import { transcriptFromViewState } from '@/lib/transcript'

const log = getLogger('web')

/** A run outside a conversation (harness without the SQLite store). Upgrades itself to
 *  /conversations/{id} when the run record turns out to carry a conversation_id. */
export function RunPage({ harness, runId }: { harness: HarnessState; runId: string }) {
  const source = useMemo(() => ({ kind: 'live', runId }) as const, [runId])
  const rv = useRunView(harness.client, source)
  const [workspaceOpen, setWorkspaceOpen] = useState(true)
  const live = rv.state.status === 'running' || rv.state.status === 'queued'

  useEffect(() => {
    const client = harness.client
    if (!client) return
    let cancelled = false
    void client
      .getRun(runId)
      .then((rec) => {
        if (cancelled || !rec.conversation_id) return
        log.info('run.upgrade', 'run belongs to a conversation; redirecting', {
          run_id: runId,
          conversation_id: rec.conversation_id,
        })
        navigate({ kind: 'conversation', id: rec.conversation_id, runId }, { replace: true })
      })
      .catch(() => undefined)
    return () => {
      cancelled = true
    }
  }, [harness.client, runId])

  useEffect(() => {
    document.title = `${rv.state.scenarioId ?? 'run'} · ${runId} — Faultline`
  }, [rv.state.scenarioId, runId])

  const transcript = useMemo(() => transcriptFromViewState(rv.state, live), [rv.state, live])
  const src: TranscriptSource = live ? (rv.transport?.mode === 'poll' ? 'poll' : 'sse') : 'record'

  return (
    <div className="flex h-dvh min-h-0 flex-col">
      <TopBar
        crumbs={[{ label: 'Runs', route: { kind: 'home' } }, { label: rv.state.scenarioId ? `${rv.state.scenarioId} · ${runId}` : runId }]}
        onToggleWorkspace={() => setWorkspaceOpen((v) => !v)}
        workspaceOpen={workspaceOpen}
      >
        <RunStatusStrip state={rv.state} transport={rv.transport} source={src} />
      </TopBar>
      <div className="flex min-h-0 flex-1">
        <div className="flex min-h-0 min-w-0 flex-1 flex-col">
          <TranscriptView
            transcript={transcript}
            diffs={rv.state.diffs}
            maxSteps={rv.state.maxSteps}
            loading={rv.loading}
            loadingLabel="Loading run…"
            error={rv.loadError}
            transport={rv.transport}
          />
        </div>
        <WorkspacePanel state={rv.state} live={live} open={workspaceOpen} onOpenChange={setWorkspaceOpen} />
      </div>
    </div>
  )
}

import { useEffect, useMemo, useState } from 'react'

import { RunStatusStrip } from '@/components/layout/RunStatusStrip'
import { TopBar } from '@/components/layout/TopBar'
import { TranscriptView } from '@/components/transcript/TranscriptView'
import { WorkspacePanel } from '@/components/workspace/WorkspaceColumn'
import type { HarnessState } from '@/hooks/useHarness'
import { useRunView } from '@/hooks/useRunView'
import { DEMOS } from '@/lib/replay'
import { transcriptFromViewState } from '@/lib/transcript'

/** Bundled recorded run, played back at replay speed. Needs no backend. */
export function ReplayPage({ harness, demoId }: { harness: HarnessState; demoId: string }) {
  const source = useMemo(() => ({ kind: 'demo', demoId }) as const, [demoId])
  const rv = useRunView(harness.client, source)
  const [workspaceOpen, setWorkspaceOpen] = useState(true)
  const meta = DEMOS.find((d) => d.id === demoId)
  const live = rv.replaying

  useEffect(() => {
    document.title = `replay · ${demoId} — Faultline`
  }, [demoId])

  const transcript = useMemo(() => transcriptFromViewState(rv.state, live), [rv.state, live])

  return (
    <div className="flex h-dvh min-h-0 flex-col">
      <TopBar
        crumbs={[{ label: 'Replays', route: { kind: 'home' } }, { label: meta?.label ?? demoId }]}
        onToggleWorkspace={() => setWorkspaceOpen((v) => !v)}
        workspaceOpen={workspaceOpen}
      >
        <RunStatusStrip state={rv.state} transport={null} source="replay" replaying={rv.replaying} />
      </TopBar>
      <div className="flex min-h-0 flex-1">
        <div className="flex min-h-0 min-w-0 flex-1 flex-col">
          <TranscriptView
            transcript={transcript}
            diffs={rv.state.diffs}
            maxSteps={rv.state.maxSteps}
            loading={rv.loading}
            loadingLabel="Loading bundled run…"
            error={rv.loadError}
          />
        </div>
        <WorkspacePanel state={rv.state} live={live} open={workspaceOpen} onOpenChange={setWorkspaceOpen} />
      </div>
    </div>
  )
}

cat > src/App.tsx <<'EOF'
import { TooltipProvider } from '@/components/ui/tooltip'
import { AppShell } from '@/components/layout/AppShell'
import { useConversations } from '@/hooks/useConversations'
import { useHarness } from '@/hooks/useHarness'
import { useIdentity } from '@/hooks/useIdentity'
import { useRoute } from '@/lib/router'
import { ConversationPage } from '@/pages/ConversationPage'
import { HomePage } from '@/pages/HomePage'
import { ReplayPage } from '@/pages/ReplayPage'
import { RunPage } from '@/pages/RunPage'

/**
 * Routes (path based, no router dependency — see src/lib/router.ts):
 *   /                        new run (composer + scenarios)
 *   /conversations/:id       a conversation loaded from the SQLite store via REST; ?run=<id> picks a run
 *   /runs/:id                a run outside a conversation (harness without the store)
 *   /replay/:demoId          bundled recorded run
 */
export default function App() {
  const route = useRoute()
  const identity = useIdentity()
  const harness = useHarness()
  const conversations = useConversations(harness.client)

  let page: React.ReactNode
  switch (route.kind) {
    case 'conversation':
      page = (
        <ConversationPage
          key={route.id}
          harness={harness}
          conversations={conversations}
          conversationId={route.id}
          runId={route.runId ?? null}
        />
      )
      break
    case 'run':
      page = <RunPage key={route.runId} harness={harness} runId={route.runId} />
      break
    case 'replay':
      page = <ReplayPage key={route.demoId} harness={harness} demoId={route.demoId} />
      break
    default:
      page = <HomePage harness={harness} conversations={conversations} />
  }

  return (
    <TooltipProvider>
      <AppShell harness={harness} conversations={conversations} route={route} identity={identity}>
        {page}
      </AppShell>
    </TooltipProvider>
  )
}

# apps/web — Faultline browser UI

A chat-style viewer for Faultline runs: a Claude agent executes real shell commands in a Modal
Sandbox while the environment injects faults at the tool boundary. The UI shows every model turn,
every tool call with its output, the injected fault and whether the agent recovered, the workspace
diff, and the graded score — grouped into **conversations that belong to this browser**.

Static SPA, served by the Modal app `faultline-web` (Server `site`); talks to the harness API over
CORS. See `../../ARCHITECTURE.md` for the system design and `../../PLAN.md` §2.9–§2.10, §3.3 for
the plan.

## Stack

- Vite 8 · React 19 · TypeScript 6 · Tailwind v4 (`@tailwindcss/vite`)
- shadcn (v4 CLI, style `base-nova` on Base UI) — primitives + the **sidebar block** (collapsible to icons)
- [Beautiful UI](https://www.beautifului.dev) (MIT, © 2026 Shane Levine) — AI-native composites,
  copied and adapted into `src/components/bui/` (see its README/LICENSE there)
- vitest + Testing Library (jsdom)

**Node ≥ 22.12 is required** (Vite 8 / vitest 5). `.nvmrc` pins 22; the lockfile is pnpm v9
(`packageManager: pnpm@9.15.4`).

```bash
source ~/.nvm/nvm.sh && nvm use        # Node 22 from .nvmrc
corepack pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
pnpm dev                               # http://localhost:5173, harness URL from public/config.json
pnpm test                              # vitest run
pnpm build                             # tsc -b && vite build → dist/
```

## Routes (path based, `src/lib/router.ts`, no router dependency)

| Path | What |
|---|---|
| `/` | new run: composer (`/` picks a scenario, model + seed chips) and scenario cards |
| `/conversations/:id` | a conversation loaded from the SQLite store via `GET /conversations/{id}`; `?run=<id>` selects a run |
| `/runs/:id` | a run outside a conversation (harness build without the store); upgrades itself when the record carries `conversation_id` |
| `/replay/:demoId` | bundled recorded run from `public/demo/*.json`, no backend |

`serve.py` answers extension-less paths with `index.html`, so deep links work on Modal.

## Data flow

- **Identity** — `src/lib/identity.ts` mints `u_<uuid4>` once per browser (localStorage, cookie
  mirror) and every request carries `X-Faultline-User`. Conversations are scoped to it. Scoping,
  not auth.
- **Conversations** — `GET /conversations` fills the sidebar; `GET /conversations/{id}` returns
  `{conversation, runs, messages}`; finished runs render from the persisted `messages/blocks`
  projection (the top-bar chip says `sqlite`). If the harness has no such routes yet (404) the UI
  says "history unavailable" and runs still work through `POST /runs`.
- **Live runs** — seed from `GET /runs/{id}`, then tail `GET /runs/{id}/events` (SSE, resumes with
  `Last-Event-ID`, ~110 s rotations, polling fallback). `src/lib/reducer.ts` folds events into the
  view state; `src/lib/transcript.ts` maps either source onto one transcript model.
- **Config** — harness URL precedence: `window.__FAULTLINE_CONFIG__` → `/config.json` (written by
  `serve.py` from `$HARNESS_URL` at container start) → `VITE_HARNESS_URL` → built-in default.

## Layout

```
src/
  App.tsx                       route switch inside the sidebar shell
  components/app-sidebar.tsx    conversations (grouped by day) · replays · identity menu
  components/layout/            AppShell (SidebarProvider), TopBar (breadcrumb + status chips), Link
  components/transcript/        TranscriptView: task bubble → turns (AssistantText, ThinkingTrace, ToolCallChips) → ScoreRows
  components/workspace/         Files / Diffs / Timeline / Logs column (sheet on narrow screens)
  components/bui/               Beautiful UI ports (AssistantText, ThinkingTrace, ToolCallChips, CodeBlock, ScoreRows, LoadingState, FileStatusTable, Composer)
  components/ui/                shadcn primitives + sidebar block
  pages/                        HomePage, ConversationPage, RunPage, ReplayPage
  hooks/                        useHarness, useIdentity, useConversations, useConversation, useRunView, useStartRun
  lib/                          api, config, identity, router, reducer, transcript, replay, format, log, types
public/demo/                    bundled replays (export with ../../scripts/export_demo.py)
modal_app.py · serve.py         Modal Server hosting (prebuilt dist/ or in-image Node 22 build)
```

## Deploy

```bash
pnpm build
HARNESS_URL=https://appliedlabsai-local--faultline-harness-api.modal.run \
  modal deploy -e local apps/web/modal_app.py
# → https://appliedlabsai-local--faultline-web-site.modal.run
```
EOF
